How to use this book
Every unit is built around one real podcast episode. Tap or scan the QR code, listen, and work
through the sections in order — the second listening is where most of the learning happens.
1. Listen once for the main idea. Don’t stop the audio and don’t read anything. Afterwards, say in one
   sentence what the episode was about.
2. Do the listening tasks (A). Read the questions first, then listen again and answer — just like the
   real test. Check your spelling, then check the answer key at the back of the book.
3. Study the chunks (B). Learn the phrases as whole units. Listen for each one in the episode and
   write your own sentence with at least three of them.
4. Read the transcript (C). Open the official transcript and listen a third time while reading. Underline
   the words you missed and shadow 3–4 sentences.
5. Your turn (D). Answer the speaking questions out loud for 1–2 minutes each, then plan the linked
   Writing Task 2 question.

   Maslahat: Birinchi marta tinglaganda hech narsa yozmang — faqat asosiy fikrni tushunishga harakat
   qiling. Haftasiga 2–3 ta epizodni chuqur ishlash 10 tasini yuzaki tinglashdan foydaliroq.
